claims.text: AI-credited flaws reach CISA's exploited list no more often than other flaws.

restates.quote: the data does not suggest that AI discovered vulnerabilities are inherently more likely to be exploited than those found through traditional methods.

claims.data_source: CISA KEV and CVE List: AI-credited base rate, records listed within 90 days

claims.text: By the end of 2028, AI-powered malware is used in a ransomware attack on UK critical national infrastructure, as the UK government or the NCSC publicly confirms.

restates.quote: It is highly likely that between now and 2028, AI-powered malware will have been used in a ransomware attack on UK CNI.

claims.data_source: Statements by the UK government and the NCSC

support.text: The UK government or the NCSC states that a ransomware attack on UK critical infrastructure used AI-powered malware

challenge.text: The UK government or the NCSC states that a claimed AI-powered ransomware attack on UK critical infrastructure did not use AI-powered malware
